description: This file defines a template class 'Cloneable' in the 'torch::nn' namespace, which provides a mechanism for deep copying modules using CRTP. It includes methods for cloning modules, resetting state, and managing parameters, buffers, and child modules.

classes.name: Cloneable
classes.description: A CRTP-based template class that provides deep cloning functionality for modules, managing parameters, buffers, and submodules.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the module, including parameters, buffers, and child modules, optionally on a specified device.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize or reset the module's members, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: clone_
methods.description: Helper method to clone submodules, ensuring type safety via dynamic_cast.
